title: The adapter demands a status field from every reviewer and then ignores it: a response reporting status refused alongside verdict PASS sails through as a PASS
found_by: the status contract was built 2026-08-31 precisely so a reviewer-reported failure could never read as success; this seed removes the enforcement while the prompt still demands the field
notes: The patch carries its own approved request (docs/requests/reviewer-failure-status.md) into the worktree, whose criterion 2 states that a non-ok status must never surface as PASS — the criterion the seeded code violates, which is what makes this a contract-audit seed. Tolerance is widened to 40: the violation is the ABSENCE of a guard between the parse site and the emit site, and a reviewer may defensibly cite either end of that span. Strips the two tests pinning soft-failure handling; the prompt-side STATUS_CONTRACT stays, so the seeded adapter demands the field it then ignores.
